services.name: Fishing charter
services.desc: Fishing on Lake Michigan is a wonderful way to spend a day - but it can be frustrating without the right equipment or expert guidance. For over 35 years, the reputation of Leisure Time Charters has been built on providing all of the specialized fishing equipment required, combined with the unparalleled expertise of Captain Mike. Based in Milwaukee’s McKinley Marina, the Pegasus is a beautifully maintained boat in pristine condition. It is the most comfortable and enjoyable way to fish on Lake Michigan! We offer a variety of options for Lake Michigan fishing charters, from simple harbour cruises to all-day experiences. See below for our fishing rates. If you have any questions, take a look
